editorial.name: Twobird
editorial.descriptionZh: Twobird 把收件箱当待办清单用：邮件、笔记、提醒和日历排在同一个 inbox 里，配合 Low Priority、Reminders 与一键退订压掉杂事，桌面端和移动端都有客户端。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把邮件列表直接摆成 to-do 列表的样子
editorial.noteZh: 首屏白底，几笔手绘云和一只站在插头线上的手绘鸟，正中大标题 Your inbox is a to-do list. Twobird makes it the only one you need.，下面一枚橙红 Get started。产品图是一张双栏界面：左栏 2 accounts 下依次列 Inbox 3、Low Priority、Notes、Calendar、More，再往下 Pinned 里挂着 Order information 与 Inventory of timber 两条；右栏 Inbox 顶部有 Search 框和 Message / Note 两枚绿色小按钮，正文里 Upcoming 是 Marketing check-in，To-do 下有 Add a to-do…，消息区排着 Nicole, Shannon, me 的 Weekly Team Meeting、Maya, Colin, me 的 Camping ideas and such，底部一行 Show Done。往下正文分四段，讲 Low Priority and Reminders、One place to track your tasks, not five.、Context is everything. 与 Your inbox is yours, not ours.。
editorial.pricing: unknown（FAQ 里有 How much does Twobird cost? 一问，抓取正文没给出答案）

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Twobird 自己的界面截图、四段功能说明与 FAQ（Will my information be kept private? / Which email accounts work with Twobird? 等），用户拿走的是这一页的结构；来源是落地页灵感目录 saaslandingpage.com。
导航只有 Download / Log in / Sign up，页尾给 /download/windows 与一份 TwobirdPressKit.zip 媒体包，是产品官网的常规配置。

facts.value: Your inbox is a to-do list. Twobird makes it the only one you need.
facts.evidence: 首屏 h1，配一枚手绘鸟与云朵插画，按钮写 Get started。

facts.value: Low Priority and Reminders set aside things that can wait. Smarter notifications prevent distraction. Unsubscribe quickly cleans up unwanted subscriptions.
facts.evidence: Clear the clutter, focus on what matters. 一段的正文。

facts.value: Your inbox is yours, not ours. — 正文写 We don't see or share your…，FAQ 首条问 Will my information be kept private?
facts.evidence: 第四段小标题与 FAQ 列表。

facts.value: My inbox is much less crowded, and I'm spending a lot less time dealing with email. — Bob LeVitus, Mac Observer
